notes: The frame's that (t015) is given to the apodosis waw s010 rather than to haya, because the apodosis opens with its own waw and the ASV writes the word at that apodosis head (rule 45); the competing reading, which keeps it with the frame, is named in the unit's note.
s014 takes the possessive his under rule 41, no suffix standing on kisse to license it; the alternative would leave the article unrepresented and the his added under rule 18's closing sentence.
me-al is split rather than fused because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme (rules 2 and 30).
Eli (t016) is a supplied lexical subject noun answering to no morpheme in the verse, so it is added under rule 17; the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
The object marker takes the of by which make mention reaches its object (rule 16).
